title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional study hubs, quiet retreats, and collaborative zones that Bryant University students use to navigate their daily academic and social lives beyond the standard tour path.

cards.title: Janikies Innovation Forum
cards.subtitle: Academic Innovation Center (AIC)
cards.notes: Utilize the movable whiteboards and reconfigurable furniture in this open hub for group projects and dynamic brainstorming sessions.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, high-tech collaborative space at the heart of the Academic Innovation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Janikies Innovation Forum is a space where furnishings and whiteboards can be reconfigured to support various group learning activities.
cards.source_title: Academic Innovation Center – Center for Teaching Excellence
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7am-11pm, with reduced hours on weekends.

cards.title: Krupp Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Douglas and Judith Krupp Library
cards.notes: Book these private rooms online for focused group work; they feature wireless display capabilities and whiteboards.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms located within the university's main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Library study rooms may be reserved by Bryant University students for group study and collaborative work.
cards.source_title: Library Study Rooms - LibCal - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Reservations required; maximum 2 hours per booking.

cards.title: Unistructure Rotunda Lounge
cards.subtitle: The Unistructure, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Find a seat in this central academic hub for quick study breaks between classes or to meet with peer tutors.
cards.short_summary: A central lounge and service area located on the second floor of the main academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Unistructure Rotunda 2nd floor houses the IT Service Desk and provides a central meeting point for students.
cards.source_title: Campus Maps - Information Services - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; generally open late for student use.

cards.title: Fireside Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fisher Student Center, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Relax by the fireplace in this social hub, which offers a mix of lounge and café seating for casual study.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, light-filled lounge area featuring a fireplace in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of the Fisher Student Center has an inviting fireplace and a mix of lounge and café seating.
cards.source_title: A Pictorial History of Bryant University 1989-2018
cards.access_notes: Open daily; popular for socializing and informal meetings.

cards.title: Bello Center Reading Room
cards.subtitle: George E. Bello Center
cards.notes: Escape to this traditional reading room for silent, focused study away from the more active campus zones.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet study space within the George E. Bello Center for Information and Technology.
cards.evidence_claim: For quiet study, there is a traditional reading room in the George E. Bello Center.
cards.source_title: George E. Bello Center | Bryant University Buildings
cards.access_notes: Silent study rules strictly enforced; open during library hours.

cards.title: Interfaith Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Machtley Interfaith Center
cards.notes: Visit this smaller rotunda space for quiet reflection or meditation in a peaceful, inclusive environment.
cards.short_summary: A quiet meditation space seating 40 people within the Interfaith Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The smaller Meditation Center seats 40 and provides a welcoming space for students of all beliefs.
cards.source_title: Bryant University Interfaith Center, Rhode Island
cards.access_notes: Open to all students for spiritual support and quiet reflection.

cards.title: Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Douglas and Judith Krupp Library
cards.notes: Access 3D printers, sewing machines, and Cricut tools for creative projects; staff are available for technical help.
cards.short_summary: A creative workshop area equipped with modern fabrication tools for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: There is a Makerspace equipped with 3-D printers, a sewing machine, and a Cricut machine.
cards.source_title: George E. Bello Center | Bryant University Buildings

cards.title: AIC Breakout Rooms
cards.subtitle: Academic Innovation Center
cards.notes: Use these glass-walled rooms for group discussions; many feature digital displays and writable glass surfaces.
cards.short_summary: Modern, transparent breakout rooms designed for group collaboration and design thinking.
cards.evidence_claim: Twenty-four study and breakout rooms are available for student work in the Academic Innovation Center.
cards.source_title: Academic Innovation Center – Center for Teaching Excellence
cards.access_notes: Minimum occupancy of 3 students required for reservations.

cards.title: Wellness Center Lobby
cards.subtitle: Chace Wellness and Athletic Center
cards.notes: A high-traffic spot to meet friends before workouts or grab a quick seat between athletic events.
cards.short_summary: The main entrance and gathering area for Bryant's primary athletic and recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chace Lobby Desk serves as a central information point for the Wellness and Athletic Center.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6am to late evening during the semester.

cards.title: Bryant Pond Pathway
cards.subtitle: Central Campus
cards.notes: Walk the brick path around the pond, a scenic route connecting the Unistructure and Fisher Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A central pedestrian walkway surrounding the campus pond and the historic wrought iron archway.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 1987 funded a brick pathway around the revered arch by Bryant Pond.
cards.source_title: Exploring campus legends, landmarks, and little-known lore
